text:
elaine: Quick sync — I think we still have an ambiguity between Hosted / Dedicated / Private around secret propagation and eviction ordering. If the control plane retries to reattach secrets during a Private->Hosted fallback we might accidentally expand KMS scopes. Anyone seen this in the shim logs?

raj: saw traces in staging yesterday — eviction + rebind race. Sidecar reclaimed lease, control plane replayed manifest and re-bound a secret with a Hosted KMS policy. :grimacing: short spike in failed decrypts.

marta: ugh. short-term mitigation: stop auto-rebind when tenant is in Private mode and fallback to Hosted is active. long-term: manifest-level immutable secret IDs so rebind is a deliberate op.

raj: agree. also propose explicit flag in manifest: `rebind_allowed: true|false`. that makes policy explicit and avoids implicit behaviour.

raj: example manifest snippet:```
service: inference
version: 2025-05-12
rebind_allowed: false   # default false for private tenants during fallback
secret_binding: kms:b-tenant-private
```

ops-bot: deploy-canary: 2025-05-12T14:22Z - observed 502s on the rebind path, correlated with control-plane retries.

nick: another idea — add a small circuit breaker: if rebind fails >= 3 times within 60s, mark tenant routing read-only and surface a pager. prevents repeated KMS expansion attempts.

marta: +1 on circuit breaker. also add telemetry tag `rebind_attempt` and `rebind_result` to traces so we can alert before it affects requests.

elaine: action items: @raj draft a short RFC for `rebind_allowed` + compatibility rules; @marta add unit + integration tests for rebind=false; @nick sketch circuit-breaker behaviour and alert thresholds. ping @ops for a safe canary window.

raj: I'll open the RFC PR by EOD. compatibility note: default for existing manifests = true (preserve current behaviour) but private-tenants created after RFC default to false. we can flip via tenant patch.

marta: also note in console we should expose `redwoodctl tenant update --rebind-allowed=false` and surface a warning when toggling.

nick: for SRE runbook: if rebind flaps, run `redwoodctl logs --tenant <id> --filter rebind_attempt` and escalate if >5 failures in 10m.

elaine: thanks all — this feels actionable. I'll add cards to the architecture board and tag owners. :thumbsup:

raj: thanks, will follow up with RFC link here.

ops-bot: note: rolling canary window requested 2025-05-13 01:00-03:00 UTC by @elaine

marta: one more edge case: deployments with sidecarless private mode might still try local secret proxies; we need to document that `rebind_allowed=false` does not prevent manual operator rebinds. mention in RFC.

elaine: yep, callout in RFC and runbook. end of thread.
